# netbox_virtual_circuit (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/circuits/virtualcircuit/):

> A virtual circuit is a logical connection between interfaces that rides on a provider network, for example an L2 service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_virtual_circuit" "example" {
  cid                 = "example"
  provider_network_id = netbox_circuit_provider_network.example.id
  type_id             = netbox_virtual_circuit_type.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cid` (String) Unique circuit ID.
- `provider_network_id` (Number)
- `type_id` (Number)

### Optional

- `comments` (String)
- `custom_fields` (Map of String)
- `description` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number)
- `provider_account_id` (Number)
- `status` (String) One of [planned, provisioning, active, offline, deprovisioning, decommissioned].
- `tags` (Set of String)
- `tenant_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String)
